forum.title: New community platform: way slower than the previous one and answered question not really highlighted
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@nico23 ,

Thanks for sharing your feedback.

I understand the speed issue is now resolved, is that correct?

The comments about the best answer and its display are noted. The adjustment to the new platform might take some time.

However, member feedback is being closely monitored. If you and other members still feel the same way about this, the issue can be reviewed to identify improvements.

Kind regards,

Lina
